name: nursing-vp-sim
description: Nursing Virtual Patient Simulator — LLM-powered medical history interview training

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --log-level debug
scripts.check: pnpm run check:backend && pnpm run check:frontend
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check .
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm biome lint . && pnpm tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest -x -q
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:migration: cd backend && uv run python -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:downgrade: cd backend && uv run python -m alembic downgrade -1
scripts.api:spec: cd backend && uv run python -c "from main import app; import json; json.dump(app.openapi(), open('../openapi.json','w',encoding='utf-8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2); print('spec written')"
scripts.api:update: pnpm run api:spec && pnpm run api:generate
scripts.api:update:all: pnpm run api:spec && pnpm run api:generate && pnpm run api:generate:miniapp
scripts.check:api: pnpm run api:update:all && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/src/api/api-types.gen.ts miniprogram/api/types.gen.ts
